title: Lifting Business Development Manager
description: We’re looking for the very best talent to join us at this exciting time in our journey, as we continue to strengthen our market leader position by providing an even better customer experience. We have an exciting new role for a Regional Business Development Manager covering the South West with the primary aim of winning and developing revenue streams from large major customers in the Lifting sector. Working closely with the sales and account management team to develop and delivery a commercial strategy for our products in order to achieve high ROI goals in accordance to the Sunbelt Rentals business objectives This will be done by optimizing revenue incomes through multiple sales channels (National, Regional and Internal), identifying and marketing differentiated value propositions through alternative markets and growth sectors and instigating a training and development program to improve the order capture conversion rate and overall customer experience. Your Responsibilities Will Include Create and implement a performance management process for the Lifting Sales community to improve capability, call activity, portfolio and area growth Develop and manage a National project and portfolio pipeline to drive new business growth through relevant sales channels and business sectors Work closely alongside the National accounts team to create a plan to promote & increase the Lifting ‘Share of wallet’ within National Accounts Develop & co-ordinate training programs to increase product knowledge and working at height safety awareness across relevant Sales Channels and Hire Desks in order to create teams of ‘Trusted Advisors’. Work alongside marketing to align campaigns and collateral with new products, services and underutilized products. Identify new markets and underpenetrated sectors and create strategy to gain traction and market share Develop systems and controls for pricing to improve governance, discounting and overall ROI. Promote cross selling opportunities through all division of Sunbelt Rentals divisions. What can we offer you in return? You’ll be joining a highly successful FTSE100 company, the UK’s largest equipment rental provider. We provide an Industry leading flexible rewards package including generous holiday allowance (with the opportunity to buy and sell annual leave), life assurance, retail discount scheme, employee recognition awards and a great Company pension scheme. Other benefits will depend on your job role and may include company car and private medical insurance. If you join the team we’ll provide you with everything you need and ensure you are equipped for success. We’ll talk to you about your training and personal development needs and what you’d like to do to further your career and support your future aspirations. To succeed as a Regional Business Development Manager you will bring the following skill-set and behaviours: You will have already undertaken an Account Management role and have significant experience in the Plant and Tool Hire Industry, preferably in with experience in Lifting equipment. You will have the experience, confidence and ability to positively and professionally represent Sunbelt Rentals and develop strong and successful relationships with key external stakeholders. You will also be able to demonstrate the experience and ability to lead on tender bids ensuring profitability and good ROI. Key to success will be your ability to enable collaboration as you’ll work with the Procurement team, Tenders & Bids Team, Marketing team and all sales colleagues from across the group The Essential Requirements Considerable sales experience of working closely with large customers Sales Management experience - able to manage and develop a team of sales colleagues Commercial Acumen - to ensure competitive contracts are proposed and bid for Tender & Bid writing - able to contribute to sizable bid opportunities Excellent communication and presentation skills - both internally and externally Good understanding of hire contracts and terms Teamwork - able to work across teams and across the company to build customers proposals and form commercial contracts Why Sunbelt? Whether it's construction sites, energy projects, government initiatives, or unforgettable events, Sunbelt Rentals deliver the equipment and expertise to move every industry forward. With our ambition to an employer of choice this makes Sunbelt Rentals an ideal destination for your next career move. We are committed to the fair treatment of our staff, potential staff, and users of our services, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, responsibilities for dependants, age, physical/mental disability, or offending background. Having a criminal record will not automatically bar an individual from working with us. We judge each case on its own merits, taking into account the relevance of the conviction to the role, the circumstances, and the time passed since the offence.

title: Medical Imaging and Radiophysics
description: Company Description Zenbaba General Hospital is a healthcare facility serving the community in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, with a focus on accessible and reliable medical services. The hospital provides a range of clinical and diagnostic services aimed at improving patient outcomes and supporting public health. Team members work in a multidisciplinary environment that values collaboration, ethical practice, and continuous learning. Zenbaba General Hospital is committed to maintaining high standards of patient care and investing in modern medical technologies and professional development. Role Description The Medical Imaging and Radiophysics professional will work on-site at Zenbaba General Hospital in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia in a full-time capacity. Day-to-day responsibilities include performing and optimizing medical imaging procedures, supporting radiology and nuclear medicine services, and ensuring accurate image acquisition for diagnostic use. The role involves monitoring and managing radiation safety measures, calibrating and maintaining imaging equipment, and assisting in the development of imaging protocols in line with best practices and regulatory requirements. The professional will collaborate with physicians, technologists, and other healthcare staff to interpret technical data, troubleshoot equipment issues, and contribute to quality assurance and continuous improvement of imaging services. Documentation of procedures, adherence to safety guidelines, and participation in training and education activities are also key aspects of this position. Qualifications Demonstrated competency in Medical Imaging and Radiology, including practical experience with common imaging modalities. Knowledge and experience in Nuclear Medicine applications and related imaging procedures. Solid understanding of Medicine principles relevant to diagnostic imaging and patient care. Strong foundation in Radiation Safety and radiophysics, including dose optimization and compliance with safety standards. Bachelor’s or higher degree in Medical Imaging, Radiologic Technology, Medical Physics, or a closely related field. Experience working in a hospital or clinical setting, preferably in diagnostic radiology or nuclear medicine. Ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical information clearly to clinical staff. Attention to detail, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and commitment to ethical and patient-centered practice. Willingness to engage in ongoing professional development and adapt to new technologies and protocols.

title: Regional Laboratory Officer, Ethiopia, Malaria and Neglected Tropical Diseases (MNTD), REACH Malaria
description: PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges. PATH seeks a Regional Laboratory Officer for the United States Government (USG)-funded Reaching every at-risk community and household with malaria services (REACH Malaria) global project. REACH aims to provide implementation support services and technical assistance to countries to accelerate progress in comprehensive delivery of life-saving facility and community-based malaria services including malaria case management, prevention of malaria in pregnancy (MiP), seasonal malaria chemoprevention (SMC), maternal and child health services including immunization and nutrition, data collection and use for service delivery, and other malaria prevention interventions. Regional Laboratory Officer is responsible for supporting improvement of malaria laboratory diagnosis and quality assurance across REACH Malaria Project supported health facilities in the respective region. S/he is responsible for providing comprehensive technical support to health facilities, health care workers and communities to improve the quality of malaria laboratory diagnosis and quality assurance activities. S/he will be responsible for providing technical support including regular mentorship and supportive supervision and training to health facilities including health posts to improve the quality of malaria diagnosis in close collaboration with the regional, zonal, district and EQA center malaria and laboratory officers. The improved quality of malaria diagnosis will increase the quality of malaria case management services which is a life-saving intervention. Responsibilities: Provide regular mentorship to facility laboratory staff, regional and woreda malaria programs on malaria laboratory diagnosis and quality assurance Provide training to laboratory personnel and other HCWs on malaria laboratory diagnosis and quality assurance as well as integrated external quality assessment Assist development and/or review of support tools such mentorship checklist, job aids, laboratory SOPs to be provided to each health facility to support the improvement of malaria diagnosis practices Provide comprehensive support to health facility laboratories and health posts including the distribution of essential job aids, SOPs, guidelines and manuals as well as commodities to health facilities Conduct baseline assessment and follow up tailored support to each health center and health post on malaria laboratory diagnosis and quality assurance activities. Participate in the regular regional laboratory technical working group meetings Provide technical assistance for regional planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of malaria diagnosis and quality assurance activities. Assist design of quality assurance program for malaria laboratory diagnosis and facilitate its implementation at the supported health facilities Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual plans and activity reports Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by supervisor Required skills and experience: Minimum of BSc in Laboratory sciences Recent work experience in the field of laboratory science for at least five years. Experience in malaria laboratory program implementation is an added advantage. Demonstrated experience in conducting laboratory mentorship, training and supervisions Experience in development and review of documents related to laboratory services Ability to work in team with good team spirit Computer skills (Word, Power point, Spread sheet, etc) Ability to work in team with good team spirit Ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously Excellent interpersonal skills and good team spirit Willingness to travel approximately 80% of his/her to supported health facilities PATH is dedicated to building an inclusive workforce where diversity is valued. PATH is an equal opportunity employer. Every qualified applicant will be considered for employment. PATH does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, age, national origin, marital status, disability status, political ideology, military or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Brand Manager
description: About The Role On behalf of our client, a well-established company operating in the automotive industry , we are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Brand Manager to lead and strengthen the performance of one of the company's key automotive brands in the Ethiopian market. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving brand growth, sales performance, market positioning, customer satisfaction, and operational alignment with international manufacturer standards. Key Responsibilities Business Planning & Commercial Performance Develop and implement annual brand business plans, sales targets, growth initiatives, and budgets. Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities. Support product and vehicle model planning based on Ethiopian market requirements. Monitor and drive achievement of monthly and annual sales targets. Support pricing strategies based on market conditions, competition, and commercial objectives. Brand & Marketing Management Coordinate the execution of marketing campaigns and promotional activities to strengthen brand awareness and market presence. Ensure consistent implementation of international brand and Corporate Identity (CI) standards across customer touchpoints. Support new vehicle launches, promotional events, and brand activation initiatives. Monitor brand perception and recommend initiatives to strengthen customer confidence and market positioning. Manufacturer & Stakeholder Management Serve as a key liaison between the local business and international manufacturer representatives. Prepare and submit regular sales, inventory, and performance reports. Coordinate manufacturer directives, technical updates, training programs, and knowledge-transfer initiatives. Participate in relevant manufacturer meetings, workshops, and training programs. Sales & Dealership Support Support and guide sales teams with product knowledge, vehicle features, and brand requirements. Monitor dealership and sub-dealer compliance with brand standards and operational policies. Coordinate with relevant teams on demand planning, shipment requirements, and inventory management. Monitor vehicle inventory and support initiatives to minimize slow-moving and aging stock. Customer Experience & After-Sales Coordination Work closely with after-sales and spare parts teams to support service quality and customer satisfaction. Monitor customer feedback and complaints and coordinate appropriate corrective actions. Review relevant warranty and maintenance reports to ensure alignment with manufacturer requirements. Support initiatives aimed at strengthening customer loyalty and protecting the brand's reputation. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Management, Automotive Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience. Experience in the automotive industry, automotive sales, dealership operations, brand management, or commercial management is highly desirable. Experience working with international automotive manufacturers or dealership networks is an advantage. Strong understanding of sales performance, market analysis, customer management, and commercial operations.

title: Welcome Supervisor 2
organization: International Committee of the Red Cross - ICRC
description: What We Do Since 1863, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has worked to preserve human dignity and relieve suffering caused by war and armed violence. In collaboration with our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners around the world, we do everything we can to deliver life-saving aid, reconnect families and locate missing people – helping those who need it most, regardless of who they are and what side of the front line they are on. We engage with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, pressing for access to detainees to improve their living conditions and urging compliance with international humanitarian law to protect non-combatants, including from digital threats. Purpose The position is responsible for the effective day-to-day management and supervision of the Welcome unit, ensuring continuity, quality and timely delivery of Welcome services to ICRC Ethiopia delegation staff and guests. The position coordinates staff travel, accommodation, arrival and departure arrangements, administrative formalities and related services, while ensuring effective coordination with internal stakeholders, relevant authorities and external service providers. The position also contributes to strengthening the efficiency, consistency and customer orientation of the Welcome function through effective team management, clear working procedures, performance monitoring, information management and continuous improvement. During the temporary assignment, particular attention will be given to ensuring operational continuity, stabilizing the team and working processes, supporting the integration of the replacement staff, and ensuring an effective handover and sustainable functioning of the unit Relationships Internally, interacts with ICRC mobile and resident staff. Externally, interacts with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Airport and immigration authorities, travel agencies/airlines/transport companies and any other relevant for the position. Accountabilities & Functional Responsibilities Welcome Department Management and Service Delivery Supervises and coordinates the activities of the Welcome Department, ensuring effective, timely and quality delivery of services to staff, visitors and guests. Plans and allocates work within the Welcome team, clarifying roles, responsibilities, workload and back-up arrangements to ensure continuity, accountability and efficient service delivery. Supervises, coaches and provides guidance to Welcome Department staff, in coordination with the Administration and relevant managers. Ensures effective induction, integration, knowledge transfer and onboarding of new or replacement Welcome staff. Ensures that Welcome services are delivered in line with ICRC institutional policies, procedures, security requirements, financial rules and applicable local requirements. Staff Travel and Movement Coordinates and ensures the timely and cost-effective organization of staff travel and movements, including flights, road travel, bus/train transportation and related logistical arrangements. Ensures appropriate coordination for staff departures and arrivals, including airport/station pick-up and drop-off, accommodation and onward transportation when required. Coordinates with ICRC offices, sub-delegations, delegations and Headquarters regarding staff travel, missions, transfers, events, seminars, courses and other movements. Ensures that travel and movement arrangements are communicated in a timely and accurate manner to the relevant staff, Welcome teams, departments and other concerned parties. Supervises the Welcome team to ensure that all arrangements related to staff movements are properly planned and followed up. Provides support and coordination for travel related to end-of-mission, compensation leave, seminars, courses, annual leave and other official travel. Coordinates travel arrangements and related requirements with relevant ICRC offices and Headquarters when required, including flight plans, accommodation, visa requirements and other travel documentation. Ensures appropriate follow-up on new arrivals and departing staff, including communication of flight plans, accommodation and transportation requirements to the relevant teams and departments. Visa, Immigration and Authorities Coordinates and follows up with relevant authorities, ministries, embassies, consulates and other institutions regarding visas, permits, registrations, certificates and other administrative requirements. Ensures that staff have the necessary and valid travel and immigration documentation for professional travel and missions, and follows up on renewals or applications as required. Supports staff, where appropriate, with relevant embassy or consular registration and administrative formalities. Maintains updated information on visa and immigration procedures and ensures that relevant guidance is communicated to concerned staff. title: Surgical Program Coordinator-Hawasa
description: Operation Smile is an international Non for-profit organization that offers free surgeries to people born with cleft conditions. We envision a world in which health and dignity are improved through safe surgery. Founded in 1982, Operation Smile has had its presence in Ethiopia since 2005 with full blown programs in Jimma University Medical Centre, St Paul’s Hospital Millennium Medical College, Ayder Comprehensive Specialized Hospital and Hawassa University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital. Operation Smile Ethiopia (OSE) office is hiring Surgical Program Coordinator for its program at Hawassa University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital (HUCSH). This is a full-time employment position based in Hawassa Hospital, Hawassa, Sidaama Region,Ethiopia and reports to the Program Manager of OSE. Key Roles And Responsibilities Program Coordination and Management Serve as the primary Operation Smile Ethiopia representative based in Hawassa, Sidama Region. Coordinate the planning, implementation, monitoring, evaluation, and reporting of all Operation Smile Ethiopia’s surgical, education and other program activities conducted at the hospital,in Sidama region and surrounding areas. Develop periodic work plans and monitor implementation against agreed objectives. Coordinate Short-Term Surgical Programs (STSPs), Surgical Education Programs (SEPs), Visiting Professorships (VPs), fellowships, workshops, and other capacity-building initiatives. Prepare timely program updates, reports, and documentation for Operation Smile Ethiopia leadership. Patient Care Coordination Coordinate identification, recruitment, admission, referral, and scheduling of cleft patients for surgical care at HUCSH. Ensure patients receive appropriate pre-operative and post-operative care and follow-up. Coordinate referrals and linkage to comprehensive cleft care services, including Nutrition, Dental care Speech therapy, Psychosocial support Facilitate transportation, accommodation, meals, and other logistical support for patients and caregivers participating in surgical programs. Ensure patient information is accurately documented using both hospital records and Operation Smile systems, including Patient Health Record (PHR) forms. Medical Volunteer Management and Workforce Development Serve as the focal person for the recruitment, engagement, coordination, and retention of medical volunteers at HUCSH. Work closely with hospital leadership to identify and recruit qualified surgeons, anesthesiologists, nurses, pediatricians, dentists, speech therapists, biomedical staff, and other multidisciplinary team members for Operation Smile programs. Work closely with OSE Education coordinator to Coordinate recruitment of healthcare professionals for Operation Smile education programs, fellowships, trainings, and professional development opportunities. Maintain an updated database of medical volunteers and monitor participation in Operation Smile activities. Ensure all participating medical volunteers maintain valid licenses, certifications and required Operation Smile credentialing documentation. . Quality Assurance and Patient Safety Ensure all program activities comply with Operation Smile Global Standards of Care and patient safety requirements. Collaborate with the Regional Medical Officer of Operation Smile,Program Manager of OSE and hospital clinical leadership to strengthen quality improvement initiatives. Support continuous quality improvement initiatives within surgical and education programs. Monitor implementation of patient safety protocols during all Operation Smile activities. Work collaboratively with hospital teams to address identified quality gaps Medical Supplies, Equipment and Logistics Collaborate with hospital relevant departments to identify infrastructure, equipment, and medical supply needs for cleft and reconstructive surgery services. Coordinate with OSE Logistics Coordinator for timely requests of medical supplies and consumables required for HUCSH. Support customs clearance and receipt of donated medical equipment and supplies for the hospital. Ensure proper storage, inventory management, utilization, and reporting of medical supplies and equipment at HUCSH. Maintain accurate inventory records and communicate replenishment needs promptly. Community Engagement and Patient Recruitment Work closely with OSE Senior Patient Coordinator to plan and implement community mobilization activities to recruit cleft patients to sequence for surgery. Coordinate patient recruitment outreach activities for cleft surgical services. Support development of awareness creation materials for radio, social media, print media, and community outreach activities. Collaborate with HUCSH relevant department to increase community awareness about cleft conditions and available treatment services.
